name: Grade 5 — Mathematics
subject: mathematics
description: Fractions, percentages, basic geometry and arithmetic

questions.question: What is the area of a rectangle with length 8 cm and width 5 cm?
questions.explanation: Area of a rectangle = length × width = 8 × 5 = 40 cm².

questions.question: Which fraction is the largest?
questions.explanation: Converting to decimals: 1/2=0.5, 3/8=0.375, 2/5=0.4, 4/9≈0.44. So 1/2 is largest.

questions.question: A train travels 360 km in 4 hours. What is its average speed?
What is the LCM of 4 and 6?
questions.explanation: Multiples of 4: 4,8,12... Multiples of 6: 6,12... First common multiple = 12.
